svg.text: Each bar spans the stages its unit works in. Prediction runs ahead of fetch; the FTQ decouples them. One column is one cycle within a pipeline; the two pipelines are not aligned in time.
fetch pipeline (IFU), then ibuf and decode
Every stage after p1 is a redirect source; the FTQ never waits for a predictor later than p1.
predecode writeback; the FTQ derives the redirect and flushes from K+1
flush: both IFU pipelines drop every block at or after the flush index
backend redirect, resolution and commit to the FTQ; the redirect also clears the ibuf
Redirect to the first translation request for the flush index
